descriptions.notStarted: I keep seeing these fireplaces around the house. I wonder if they lead anywhere...maybe Edmunds knows?  He mentioned something about a key.  I should press him a bit more.
descriptions.inProgress: My hunch was right.  The fireplaces are interconnected through the mansion's Chimney; perhaps I can use them as an alternate way of navigating through the house.  However, they're locked and Edmunds holds the only key.  He will reluctantly give me the key if I collect #b20 of each type of Gummy Slimes#k. There's Red, Green, Purple and Orange ones; so I'll need to hunt all over the house to get them.  It'll be tempting to eat them first.
descriptions.completed: Edmunds reluctantly gave me the #dOmni Key#k after I collected the Gummy Slimes for him.  With it, I can enter the fireplaces throughout the house and the Chimney to which they all connect. Hmmm... who knows where all these fireplaces lead?
